data.title: EasyList
data.short_description: EasyList is an all-in-one operations platform for managing freelancers, clients, orders, financial reports, and franchises in one place.
data.description: EasyList is a web system built for businesses that run on freelancers and sales agents. It provides a full admin dashboard to manage clients, freelancers, orders, and transfers with affiliate marketing, role-based financial reports, franchise management, user permissions, and an educational library fully supporting Arabic and English.
data.challenge:
Companies working with freelancers and sales agents often struggle with:

Scattered client and freelancer data across Excel sheets and files
Hard-to-track orders, transfers, and dues
No clear financial visibility per role (Sales, HR, Finance, CEO)
Complex affiliate marketing and client referral trees
Weak access control across teams and franchise partners
data.solution: EasyList unifies operations in one platform: freelancers, clients, orders, transfers, affiliate marketing, detailed financial reporting, franchises, roles & permissions, and inventory so teams move faster with clearer visibility.

related_projects.title: Multi-Vendor Salon & Beauty Booking Platform
related_projects.short_description: A multi-vendor beauty platform connecting salons, independent professionals, and customers. Users can discover services and products, book appointments, shop online, and use offers, while administrators manage operations, orders, and payments.
related_projects.description: A complete marketplace for salon and beauty services. Customers can browse salons and independent professionals by city and category, review profiles and ratings, select a service or package and an available time slot, then book an appointment or place a product order. The platform includes management of salons, specialists, freelancers, services, packages, products, stock, offers, and orders. The admin dashboard covers bookings, sales statistics, users, content, commissions, payments, inquiries, and complaints. The project includes a customer web interface, an admin dashboard, and an API for customer and provider apps.
related_projects.challenge: Managing multiple salons, independent professionals, and their products in one system while coordinating availability, tracking bookings and orders, and giving customers a clear experience across locations and providers.
related_projects.solution: A unified platform that connects service and product discovery with booking, shopping, payment, and order tracking. It provides a customer experience, provider tools for services and orders, and a central dashboard for content, operations, and reporting.

key_features.title: Discover Salons & Professionals
points: Browse salons and independent beauty professionals by city and category.
Search providers and explore nearby results and detailed profiles.
View salon information, photos, location, opening hours, and ratings.
Highlight popular salons and professionals in discovery views.

key_features.title: Appointment Booking

Assign bookings to a salon, freelancer, or specialist.
Capture addresses, customer notes, pricing, discounts, and tax.
Track booking status, details, and appointment history.
View appointments on a calendar and filter them by date.
Generate and view printable appointment invoices.

key_features.title: Services & Packages
points: Manage beauty service categories and their services.
Set service duration, price, description, images, and status.
Create multi-service packages with pricing, duration, and discounts.
Associate packages and services with salons or available professionals.

key_features.title: Salons & Providers

Manage independent professionals, services, and working hours.
Manage salon specialists and connect them to bookings.
Receive and review salon and professional registration requests.
Configure home service, shop, and availability options per provider.

key_features.title: Product Marketplace
points: Browse beauty products by category, subcategory, and brand.
Manage product photos, descriptions, prices, discounts, and attributes.
Track stock availability and feature products in offers or home views.
Save favorite products and view product ratings.

key_features.title: Orders & Delivery
points: Place product orders and track their status and details.
Support delivery addresses, delivery fees, tax, and discounts.
View orders for salons, professionals, and customers by role.
Generate and view printable product order invoices.

key_features.title: Payments & Wallet
points: Manage payment methods and payment records for bookings and orders.
Support cash on delivery and configurable online payment integrations.
Apply wallet balance to appointments and product orders.
Process refunds through supported payment gateway integrations.

key_features.title: Offers & Marketing
points: Create coupons and offers with discounts, usage limits, and expiry dates.
Target offers to salons or independent professionals.
Manage banners and homepage promotional content.
Manage referral codes and redeem referral rewards.
Publish articles and updates through a blog.

key_features.title: Accounts & Communication
points: Register customer, salon, and professional accounts and sign in.
Update profile, city, language, and contact details.
Verify phone or email and recover passwords.
Exchange messages through user chat rooms.
Send notifications and emails to selected user groups.
Receive and respond to contact messages and complaints.

key_features.title: Reviews & Trust
points: Rate salons and service providers.
Review services, packages, and products.
Display rating averages and counts on profiles and products.
Manage and review feedback from the admin dashboard.

key_features.title: Admin Dashboard & Reports
points: Manage users, administrators, salons, and professionals centrally.
Track appointment and product order statistics over time.
Manage categories, cities, brands, and static pages.
Monitor commissions, payments, registration requests, and complaints.
Configure tax, delivery fees, currency, search radius, and app settings.

key_features.title: Multiple Interfaces
points: Customer web interface for discovering services and products.
Dedicated admin dashboard for platform operations.
API supporting customer and provider applications.
Language and layout direction settings based on platform configuration.

related_projects.title: Nusk Al-Umrah
related_projects.short_description: An integrated digital platform for managing and booking Umrah and Hajj packages, including a web portal, admin dashboard, and mobile app connecting customers, agents, and management in one unified system.
related_projects.description: Nusk Al-Umrah is a comprehensive platform for religious tourism companies, enabling the creation of Umrah and Hajj packages composed of hotels, apartments, ground and air transport, meals, and additional services. It delivers a seamless booking experience for customers via the website or mobile app, alongside a powerful admin dashboard covering bookings, users, agents, and financial reporting.
related_projects.challenge: Umrah and Hajj travel agencies often rely on fragmented, manual operations: phone or spreadsheet-based bookings, disconnected hotel and transport inventory, difficulty tracking agent commissions, and no unified digital customer experience. This leads to operational errors, slower service, and challenges in scaling and data management.
related_projects.solution: A unified multi-channel platform that centralizes all booking and management operations: customers browse and book packages via web or mobile, agents manage their bookings and commissions through a dedicated portal, and administrators control inventory, packages, bookings, and users from a central dashboard with real-time statistics and automated PDF invoicing.

Browse packages and view details (images, prices, trip duration, locations)
Create bookings and add passenger information
Automatic price calculation (including age-based pricing rules)
Track booking and payment status
Confirm or cancel bookings
Download PDF invoices
Profile management and password change (mobile)

key_features.title: Admin Dashboard

Monthly booking and revenue charts
Package management (create, edit, approve, delete)
Package composition from: hotels, apartments, ground transport, air transport, meals, services
Booking management (view, update, cancel)
User, role, and permission management
Customer and corporate account management
Agent management, commission tracking, and payout
Driver management
Image upload and management

key_features.title: Agent Portal
points: Dedicated dashboard
Booking tracking
Commission tracking

related_projects.title: Esharb
related_projects.short_description: Esharb is a bilingual (Arabic/English) e-commerce catalog platform for premium hijabs and scarves, with an API-powered admin backend for products, inventory, and customer inquiries.
related_projects.description:
Esharb is an end-to-end catalog system for modest fashion products (hijabs, scarves, and accessories), combining a modern, responsive storefront

Built for the Egyptian and MENA market, the platform offers full Arabic/RTL support, EGP pricing, and direct WhatsApp integration to turn inquiries into sales. Customers can browse products by category, material, color, and price, with rich product pages featuring image galleries and color variants. The operations team manages everything from products and banners to static pages, inventory tracking, and role-based access control.
related_projects.challenge:
Many hijab and scarf retailers in the region rely solely on Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, without a professional website to showcase products systematically. This leads to:

Difficulty displaying products with multiple colors and materials
Lost inquiries scattered across social media messages
No inventory system or stock tracking
Poor search engine visibility (SEO)
Challenges managing bilingual content (Arabic & English)
No clear role-based access for team members
related_projects.solution:
We built Esharb as an integrated solution combining:

An elegant e-commerce storefront with a modern design reflecting a premium brand identity
A smart product catalog with variants (colors, prices, images), advanced filtering, and search
WhatsApp integration for auto-generated product inquiries with full details
An API-powered admin panel to manage products, categories, banners, pages, FAQs, and settings
Inventory management for stock quantities and movement tracking
Role-based permissions (Super Admin / Admin) to secure operations
SEO optimization via Sitemap, Meta Tags, and Structured Data

key_features.title: Storefront
points: Bilingual interface (Arabic/English) with RTL support
Homepage with banners, featured, new arrivals & best sellers
Product catalog with filters (category, material, color, price, availability) & sorting
Product page with image gallery, color picker & price variants
Product categories with dedicated pages
Advanced search across products & categories
WhatsApp inquiry with auto-generated message
Contact form with inquiry tracking
Static pages (About, Contact, FAQ)
SEO optimization (Sitemap, Meta, Open Graph, Schema)
Responsive design (Mobile-First)

key_features.title: Admin Panel
points: Product management (CRUD + soft delete restore)
Categories, materials & colors management
Promotional banners management
Pages & FAQs management
General settings (brand name, WhatsApp, SEO)
Inventory system with movement tracking & low-stock alerts
Inquiries & messages management
Users, roles & permissions management
File & image upload management
Dashboard stats (products, inventory, users, inquiries)
